notes.title: Shooting Blaster Big Bang Boom - Update 1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298279/605e6f9819c0bb9663b0174d2c066dfb6acc6cc5.png

Update 1.3 introduces two new bosses: the midway boss, and the final boss.

Summary: Major panic! The Xenovaarians are at a loss and cannot explain how is it that a lone pilot is mowing down the mercenaries they've hired. To this end, they dug deep inside their pockets and pulled out the big bucks! At great financial cost, they hired two powerful gangs that boast powerful massive ships that could stop our Hero from reaching Earth. These behemoth spaceships will be found half way through and at the end our Hero's journey.

Prepare to face the Midway boss, and the Final boss in Big Bang Boom's explosive scrolling space shooter.

Warning, Massive Object Approaching!


Update 1.3
[olist]
Bosses
	
	Midway boss added
	Final boss added
	

Improvements
	
	Some visual improvements
	

Bug Fixes
	
	Minor issues fixed
	
[/olist]

notes.title: Shooting Blaster Big Bang Boom - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298279/0dd7cd17b239c3c7ed8d7b3cf381460f02a37aa0.png

We have released Update 1.2 which introduces new features and mechanics into the game. Details are outlined below.

Summary: After the Xenovaarians took over Earth and obliterated our defenses, they hired different band of mercenaries to patrol the Solar System for any potential Human threat that could reclaim the planet.

Thankfully, you have shown mastery in the art of space dodge fighting, and are making headway towards Earth.

Panicking, the Xenovaarians employed three new different groups of deadly mercenaries that employ new, massive, capital ships that will try to stop your advance.

To help you with defeating these new mercenary forces, your ships have been retrofitted with WMDs: the ESDS, and the Nuclear Drop Bomb.

Warning, Massive Object Approaching!


Update 1.2 - MOA
[olist]
Mechanics
	
	Abilities
		
		Ability: ESDS (Electro Shock Defense System) - will destroy all enemy missiles on screen by shocking them once activated
		Ability: Nuke - drop it to cleanse the gaming screen of aliens and their weapons (power-ups will not be affected)
		
	Mini-bosses
		
		Massive Enemy Ships will try to impede your progress - destroy them to proceed
		
	

Bug Fixes
		
		Minor issues fixed
		
[/olist]

notes.title: Shooting Blaster Big Bang Boom - Update 1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298279/bda69699da4a7c48fc4633514c3a76c8e7525c9e.png

We have released Update 1.1 which introduces new features and new options that can help you get a richer experience when playing Shooting Blaster Big Bang Boom. Details are outlined below.

Update 1.1 - Mechanics
[olist]
Difficulty
	
	Added 4 Swarm modes (Thin/Normal/Dense/Hive)
	Thin/Normal Swarm modes
		
		The player will never run out of weapons to fire
		If any acquired weapons run out of ammo, the player automatically falls back on the Standard Gun
		The player does not need to manually switch weapons if they run out of ammo - the game will automatically switch to the next available weapon (chooses from left to right)
		
	Any other mode
		
		The player still has to manually switch weapons if they run out of ammo
		The player does not get unlimited ammo as in Thin/Normal Swarm modes - a weapon power-up will be made available within 0.5s if no weapon power ups are available on screen (remember to check the Sun if you have it enabled - some power ups may be hard to see as they may blend in with the Sun)
		
	Ships still unlock every 20 levels, however, to unlock a ship, you must play at least Normal mode - no ship unlocks during Thin modes
	You can now toggle picking up weapon powerups by pressing the "T" key on the keyboard, or hitting the Left Button on the controller - you can still pickup ammo of the currently equipped weapon
	Once damage is taken to the hull, a shield protects the ship for the next 3 seconds against any form of damage
	

Improvements
		
		More controller types are supported
		Leaderboard data-fetch has been improved
			
			If your entry doesn't currently show up in the leaderboards, relogging into the game should re-enlist your entry
			
		Weapons without ammo will not be cycled through
		Options tooltips have been improved
		On a controller, you can alternatively use the Right Trigger to shoot
		

Visuals
		
		Added travel field that is available for toggle in the Options menu
		

Bug Fixes
		
		Ship shields is now displaying properly
		Beam weapons (laser / electro shock) are no longer rendered behind the sun
		Fixed an issue where beam weapons would stop firing on their own
		Other minor fixes
		
[/olist]
